event_summary: A silver wrench-shaped object moves across the front/top edge of a black circular object and then disappears from view.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular device on the right, a tilted metallic object with a purple strip on the left, and a cable extending behind the black object. At the start, a silver wrench-shaped object is visible on the front-right/top edge of the black circular object. Over time, the silver object changes position leftward along the front/top edge of the black object, reaches the left/front side, and then is no longer visible. The other visible objects remain in place.

reasons: The tabletop, black circular object, silver wrench-shaped object, left metallic object, purple strip, and cable are visible.
The silver wrench-shaped object is already positioned on the black circular object at the start.
